settings.call: spacr.plaque.detect_wells (RGB array converted to BGR for ultralytics)

wells.source_figure: spectrum.01229-24.f003.jpg, PMC11448412 (Cabral G, Ren B, Bisio H, Otey D, Soldati-Favre D, Brown KM. Orthologs of Plasmodium ICM1 are dispensable for Ca2+ mobilization in Toxoplasma gondii. Microbiol Spectr 2024)
wells.crop: panels H and I (KCl and zaprinast plaque assays), including their printed labels
wells.outline: #FF00FF rectangle, 3 px at display size, transparent background, lossless WebP
wells.training_data_check: training/fields.csv of the detector repo lists Fig. 2 of this article (spectrum.01229-24.f002 p01 train, p03 val) but no panel of Fig. 3. Plaque crops from Fig. 3 are in the plaque segmentation dataset, which is a different model.
wells.reference_check: the 12 boxes were compared with the YOLO box labels stored for this figure in spaCR's detector review set (curation/model_review_2026-10-08/detector/02_literature/held_out, unpublished; whether they were hand-reviewed is not recorded): 12 of 12 matched, IoU 0.957 to 0.978
wells.licence_check: Europe PMC record for PMC11448412: licence cc by; article states CC BY 4.0

settings.input_dtype: float32 of the uint8 values; cellpose percentile normalisation

livecell.source: einarolafsson/live-cell-segmentation-dataset images/bbbc030_dic/bbbc030_dic__cho07.tif (BBBC030v1 image cho07.png; the three PNG channels are identical, channel 0 used)
livecell.citation: Koos K, et al. DIC image reconstruction on large cell scans. Sci Rep 6, 30420 (2016); image set BBBC030v1 of the Broad Bioimage Benchmark Collection (Ljosa V, Sokolnicki KL, Carpenter AE. Nat Methods 9, 637 (2012))
livecell.crop: none; the whole 1376 × 1032 field was run
livecell.split: test (acquisition-grouped split; group cho07 is test only)
livecell.outline: #FF00FF inner boundaries computed on the label image resized with nearest neighbour, thickened to 2 px (render.py outline_layer)

reference_check.note: single-field sanity check, not a benchmark. The model card's per-field test score for this field is F1 0.947 with 20 predictions, from the GPU evaluation; this CPU fp32 run gives 21
